ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Network Command
ruleDefinitions.description: Adversaries may look for details about the network configuration and settings of systems they access or through information discovery of remote systems

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*ipconfig\\ \\/all.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*netsh\\ interface\\ show\\ interface.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*arp\\ \\-a.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*nbtstat\\ \\-n.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*net\\ config.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*route\\ print.*"))
